integrity: SOURCE_MANIFEST.json binds maintained source controls. SHA256SUMS covers those controls, SOURCE_MANIFEST.json, and reconstructed payload paths. offline/manifest.json binds Git LFS objects to the locked original payload identities. Standalone exports include archive SHA256 and per-member verification. Publisher digest/signature verification is claimed only where recorded per component.
provenancePaths: Upstream/build evidence uses artifacts/ or builder absolute paths. Packaged archives are under payload/ with matching category and basename. A binary path inside an extraction tree is supplied through its archive; build-only scratch directories are intentionally absent.
runtimeNetworkPolicy: No public artifact downloads. Approved internal repository access is preferred; explicitly selected immutable internal images may be pulled during preparation. Startup never automatically pulls. Host network/egress policy is a prerequisite; shell/extension tools are not network-sandboxed by config flags.

artifactPolicy.requiredInput: Receiving agent completes phase workflow/preservation plans, phase1 OMP-only host plan and phase2 remaining host/native/core/profile plans from actual onsite discovery.
artifactPolicy.scope: Controller selects runtime artifacts; hostctl installs whole tools/assets; native helper uses scoped APT; profile installer merges native skills/hooks. Receiving agent discovers and qualifies private supply and real consumers.
artifactPolicy.replacement: Preserve adequate components; inspect ownership, paths, consumers and compatibility before a necessary replacement; retain backups, prior link targets and rollback.
artifactPolicy.paths: OS packages own distro paths such as /usr/bin. Standalone tools use versioned /opt locations and inspected /usr/local/bin entrypoints. Python libraries use the intended interpreter environment.
artifactPolicy.retirement: After replacement and real scoped consumer checks, exact unmanaged old active files/links move to quarantine. After complete two-phase acceptance, exact quarantine objects are privately archived and deleted; package-owned paths use the package manager.

validation.controllerPayload: Actual payload extraction from existing verified cache, executable versions, Compose schema and idempotent preparation tested; see provenance/r2-controller-payload-test.json. Earlier baseline evidence remains separately recorded.
validation.paperclipIntegrationScope: Real image contents in no-external-route namespaces, with explicitly test-only network-interface metadata fixture; not Docker-daemon qualification
validation.workerMocks: OpenCode and managed OMP local streaming inference; mock is not actual internal model reasoning
validation.sourceBuild: Managed OMP CLI build and patched adapter offline build passed; Rust closures resolved offline; not all upstream native builds/CI targets executed

knownGaps: Herdr full native rebuild requires exact unreachable Codeberg translate-c source. See payload/dependencies/HERDR-ZIG-REBUILD-LIMITATION.md; prebuilt Herdr runtime is complete.
Destination Docker/Compose installation, real internal model/tool quality, OMP durable sessions and Paperclip-to-OMP runs require onsite acceptance.
No host OS/kernel, private repositories, internal credentials or model weights are included.
OpenCode dependency tree is supplied at pinned Bun1.3.14; alternate Bun1.4.4 replay failed upstream photon patch.
Default local_trusted mode is a trusted single-operator host arrangement, not multi-tenant isolation.
Main runtime profile is Linux x86-64; kit native package fallback is Debian13 amd64. ARM, arbitrary distributions and unknown private project dependency sets are not universally covered.

Codex needs an actual compatible internal Responses endpoint. Its full builder model turn was blocked by bwrap NETLINK_ROUTE before any provider request; target model/tool/hook execution remains required.

Native host profile installation does not prove Paperclip generated worker homes contain or trust hooks. Follow docs/CODEX_PAPERCLIP_INTEGRATION.md and qualify effective profiles before enrollment/activation.
Claude Code full runtime source is unpublished proprietary implementation. Public repository snapshots and official executable archives are provided.

Codex Cargo graph resolves offline, but full native release compilation and all V8/Rust bootstrap/optional upstream build targets are not certified. Helper-tool source snapshots do not constitute every transitive source-build environment.

Browser UI acceptance is blocked by builder Unix socket policy and remains mandatory on target; signed Debian Chromium is an explicit alternative to the inaccessible Playwright-managed browser download.
Inspect/browser qualification profile is Debian13 x86_64; distinct OS/architecture runtimes need their own tested dependency catalog.
R5 source-build limits and omitted Trivy Java class index are declared per-component; no arbitrary project dependency closure is implied.
